name: Sol
source:
A huffy and holier-than-thou man who occasionally interferes with Melanie's journey or appears almost only to scoff at her. His origins are a mystery.

He always seem to know what's about to happen, and rarely has a scratch on him no matter how tough of a fight he's facing. Usually anyone with time magic is deleted by the mechanism governing the universe (the Man in the Moon), but Ven saved Sol when he was a baby. As advised by Ven, he kept his time powers a secret for years, until...

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12606896.sol]official bio[/url]]
